capture.setup: docker run --name fxlab-d-mysql1 --hostname mysql-primary mysql:8.4 --server-id=1 --log-bin=binlog --gtid-mode=ON --enforce-gtid-consistency=ON; fxlab-d-mysql2 --hostname mysql-replica same flags with --server-id=2 --read-only=ON, CHANGE REPLICATION SOURCE TO SOURCE_HOST='fxlab-d-mysql1', SOURCE_AUTO_POSITION=1, GET_SOURCE_PUBLIC_KEY=1; START REPLICA; discovery account openmap@'%' (caching_sha2_password) with SELECT, PROCESS, REPLICATION CLIENT; schemas crm (3000 rows) and ledger (12000 + 2 rows).
capture.command: Recording TCP proxy (lab-only Go program inside apps/collectors, removed after capture) between the OpenMap database collector's real prober (Collector.Collect from the Windows host, engine option set, port = proxy) and the container's 127.0.0.1-published port; every byte each side sent is stored in order, one file per TCP connection, with wire.json indexing the direction, offset and length of each contiguous segment. Target 127.0.0.1:53308 (mysql-replica), user openmap; caching_sha2_password, no TLS.

files.name: wire.json
files.description: Index of the recorded conversation: per connection, ordered client/server segments (offset, length) into the .bin file

files.name: wire/conn-1.bin
files.description: Raw TCP bytes of connection 1 exactly as exchanged (client and server segments concatenated in order)

redactions.what: client HandshakeResponse41 auth-response (32-byte caching_sha2_password scramble of the lab account password) at byte offset 123
redactions.replacement: 32 zero bytes (same length; replay does not read client content)
